text:
nina.marketing: quick heads up — post-webinar feed showed ~1.9% of HS leads never make it to RR claimers when the external enrichment takes longer than our handshake window. SDRs reported manual claiming spikes.
jamal.ops: thanks. is the router moving them to backfill or dropping them? any sample trace? :mag_right: 
nina.marketing: sample: HS webhook accepted -> enrichment svc slow (9-12s) -> router heartbeat times out at 5s and moves record to BackfillDaemon. claim workers only poll RR so they miss these.
mike.salesops: rough idea: instead of immediate fallback, route to a temporary "staging-ring" (radar buffer) that preserves the original routing TTL for a short grace period where enrichment can finish. SDR inboxes shouldn't show staging leads.
jamal.ops: or we could have the router do a lightweight "enrich-ping" sync call on receipt: if enrich svc returns 202+progress, extend handshake by X ms. less plumbing in HS workflows.
olivia.eng: both doable. low-risk incremental plan: 1) add staging-ring queue in router; 2) HS workflow sets property radar_buffer=true on initial send; 3) router holds records in staging-ring up to 45s, polling enrichment every 4s; 4) if enrichment completes -> push to RR; else after expiry -> backfill with flag.
alex.sdr: from SDR ops, we want staging leads hidden. Also want a digest for any staging leads >10m so we can manually triage.
mike.salesops: on HubSpot we'll add an action: Route to webhook with property `radar_buffer=true` and `owner=unassigned`. Enrichment webhook will flip `radar_state=done`. I'll draft the workflow JSON for sandbox: 
```json
{
  "workflow_action": "webhook",
  "payload": {"lead_id": "{{contact.id}}", "radar_buffer": "true", "received_at": "{{timestamp}}"}
}
```
jamal.ops: metrics to add: gauge staging_ring_depth, counter staging_to_rr, counter staging_to_backfill, histogram enrich_wait_ms, alert if staging_ring_depth > 0.5% of daily lead volume for >1h.
olivia.eng: implementation notes: routing-service will gain a StagingRingConsumer and a small requeue loop. We'll also add an enrich-probe endpoint support: if enrich svc returns HTTP 202 and header `X-Enrich-ETA-ms: <n>` router will add min(ETA, 30000) to TTL. Will instrument with prometheus labels `route=staging_ring`.
nina.marketing: timeline? want fix before next webinar on Friday.
olivia.eng: I'll open PR with feature-flag `staging_ring_v1` and a canary deploy target for tomorrow 9am PT. jamal, can you coordinate HS sandbox workflow change with mike?
mike.salesops: on it. will test the workflow and post sandbox playbook steps in #marketing.
jamal.ops: also add a quick retro task: run a backfill simulation of 2% leads stalled and measure manual claim delta. Rollback plan: disable `staging_ring_v1` feature-flag.
router-bot: deploy pending: staging-ring-v1 by olivia.eng — canary scheduled. :rocket: 
alex.sdr: thanks — hide staging leads in SDR UI and add digest. ping me when digest live.
nina.marketing: awesome. after canary we'll monitor: percent of leads held, percent recovered to RR, manual_claims delta, and backfill volume. add playbook note: "Staging-ring may delay assignment up to 45s; do not manually claim unless radar_state=done or lead sits >15m." :white_check_mark:
